evidence.why: Exact shift expression and raw return.
TRK skip and debugger-jump versus NOP branches.

facts.rationale: Corrects the literal signedness while retaining both independently verified caller branches and documenting the unchecked input domain.
facts.value: Receives an __OSException identifier, evaluates the source expression `1 << exception` into a u32 mask, reads __DBInterface->exceptionMask, and returns the raw intersection. There is no interface-null guard or shift-index validation; the signed literal 1 must not be silently interpreted as 1u for arbitrary indices. OSExceptionInit uses the result to skip a marked vector when BI2DebugFlag is nonnull and its value is at least 2; otherwise it selects debugger-jump instructions for marked vectors and NOPs for unmarked vectors before installation.
